comment: The native API level this web code needs, and a fingerprint of everything native (src/update/native.test.ts). When native code, plugins or capacitor.config.ts change: raise level here and NATIVE_LEVEL in android/app/src/main/java/app/versta/ride/AppUpdatePlugin.java together, and set fingerprint to the value the test prints. A downloaded bundle that needs a higher level than the phone's APK is never applied: the phone shows that a one-time install is needed.
